provenance.source: Individual Income Tax Law of the PRC (2018 revision) arts. 3 and 6; State Taxation Administration annual comprehensive income rate table; PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, China (reviewed 22 July 2026)
provenance.notes: PwC confirmed the seven-band structure from 3% to 45% with quick deductions on 31 August 2026 but did not print the thresholds. The thresholds and quick deductions here are the standard published table and were corroborated by a search, not by the State Taxation Administration directly.

verificationTodo: Confirm the seven thresholds and their quick deductions against the State Taxation Administration table.

omissions: Social insurance and the housing provident fund are city-specific and are not computed. Enter your own annual figure to have them deducted.
The preferential treatment of annual one-off bonuses is not modelled.
Expatriate allowances for housing, schooling and home leave are not modelled.
The cumulative withholding method, under which your monthly net pay falls through the year as you climb the annual brackets, is not reproduced; this computes the annual liability.

basicDeduction.note: A flat CNY 60,000 a year, the same for everyone, taken before any other deduction.

brackets.legalRef: Annual comprehensive income rate table, IIT Law
brackets.note: China prints this table as a rate plus a quick deduction, which is how a Chinese payroll system computes it.

regions.name: China
regions.note: IIT rates are national. Social insurance and the housing fund vary by city, and this app does not compute them.

inputSchema.label: Gross salary (per month)
inputSchema.help: Gross monthly pay. Chinese withholding is cumulative, so your net pay falls through the year as your cumulative income climbs the brackets, even on an unchanged salary.

inputSchema.label: IIT withheld (per month)
inputSchema.help: Tax withheld each month, for the annual reconciliation comparison.

inputSchema.label: Social insurance and housing fund paid
inputSchema.help: Your own annual contributions. Rates and bases are set city by city, so this app cannot compute them; take the figure from your payslips.

inputSchema.label: Special additional deductions
inputSchema.help: Children's education, continuing education, serious illness, mortgage interest or rent, elderly support and infant care. Each has its own monthly standard amount; enter the annual total you qualify for.
